Name: Bachelorette Paintings
Author: sanora
Description:
With 1.6 came new spouse paintings to hang on your wall.  If you're playing vanilla, that's fine.  If you've turned all the bachelors into bachelorettes, that can be off putting.

This is a simple mod that just changes their paintings accordingly.

I used the sprites from Girl Mod for Stardew 1.5.1 by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/93141953]KonaKona7[/url] to make this.  It's a mod made for personal use but since it bothered me, maybe it bothers you.

The mod works on my setup so it should work for you.  Anyone that wants to put this in one of those combined girl packs is free to do so [b]as long as it doesn't violate anyone's permissions.  [/b]If you want to edit this further, I think I selected the correct options to grant it.  I don't know.  This is my first mod on the Nexus.

If you want fancier portraits, as these are pretty close to vanilla, you can find some here[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22912] (CP) Hitme's Spouse Portraits Reworked[/url] as they've just updated their mod to include Bachelorette portraits.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7440]
Girl Mod for Stardew 1.5.1[/url]﻿ by KonaKona7
